# Taxonomy of Grid-Based Logic Puzzles

## 1. Loop Drawing
*Draw a single continuous loop through the grid*
- Masyu
- Slitherlink
- Mid-loop
- Dotchi-Loop
- Nagareru
- Moon-or-Sun
- Suraromu
- Yajilin

## 2. Path & Connection Drawing
*Draw paths, bridges, or lines connecting elements*
- Numberlink
- Hashiwokakero
- Pencils

## 3. Cell Shading (Black/White)
*Determine which cells to shade black*
- Nurikabe
- Heyawake
- Kurodoko
- Kurotto
- Akari
- Norinori
- Nurimisaki
- Nurimeizu
- Nuritwin
- Hitori

## 4. Region Division & Partitioning
*Divide the grid into regions or blocks*
- Shikaku
- Five Cells
- Sashigane
- Double Choco
- LITS

## 5. Number/Symbol Placement
*Fill cells with numbers or symbols*
- Sudoku
- Fillomino
- Ripple Effect
- Makaro
- Nansuke
- Juosan

## 6. Shape & Pattern Formation
*Place or identify shapes, paint regions, or form specific patterns*
- Choco Banana
- Shakashaka
- Tilepaint
- Chained Block
- Evolomino
- Sto-stone

## 7. Object Movement & Placement
*Move or position objects within the grid*
- Satogaeri
- Yosenabe
- Hebi
- Usowan
